purpose: Test whether the exact rescue caused by invoking at the first decoded sentence boundary remains stable under every combination of the next four dynamic decisions.
policy_enumeration: lexicographic_binary restricted to the exact-positive first-decision branch
paper_boundary_definition: A delimiter-token set D (e.g. commas and periods); the trigger acts only when the current token belongs to D.
boundary_detection: decoded last-token suffix plus full generated-prefix validation, allowing fused sentence-ending tokens
inference_boundary_rule: decoded comma/period/newline suffix, excluding numeric commas, numeric periods, blank lines, unclosed GSM8K calculator spans, and punctuation immediately following an unfinished arithmetic operator
depth_5_interpretation: same checkpoint with the diagnostic inference-augmentation ceiling raised from three to five
